# Ai_ReadAngleOrAtan2Fallback — 0x542280

<!-- Generated by tools/reference.py. -->

Original x86 returns context+0x50 for ordinary ordered nonsentinel values; exact 10000.0 branches to two signed coordinate deltas, 0x5E743A atan2 and float-rounded pi. ABI and runtime VERIFY; corrects 23H one-axis inference.
